prompt: File a production database request for Nina Patel, she starts Monday.

reply.message: I can't file the Production database request for Nina Patel: only Nina Patel or their direct manager can ask for access for them; Nina Patel hasn't started yet; other systems can be requested once onboarding has started. Access requests (POL-ACC-01): Any employee can ask the helpdesk to file an access request for themselves. A manager can file one for a direct report. Nobody else can file a request on someone's behalf. The helpdesk files requests; it never grants or approves access itself, and nobody can approve their own request. Standard systems are approved by the employee's manager. Elevated systems (Finance ERP, HRIS) are approved by the system owner. Restricted systems (Payroll, Production database, Cloud admin console) are approved by Security. Approval usually takes 1 business day for standard systems and up to 3 business days for elevated and restricted systems. Contractor access always ends on the contract end date. Onboarding new hires (POL-ONB-01): Onboarding is started by the new hire's manager or by HR. The new hire must already have a directory record with status pre_start; if there is no record, HR has to create it first. Onboarding can start no earlier than 5 business days before the start date. Starting onboarding creates email, team chat and HR portal accounts plus the department's standard system (Engineering: code repository, Sales: CRM, Operations: TMS, Finance: Finance ERP, HR: HRIS, IT: VPN), and ships a laptop to arrive the business day before the start date. Any other system is requested separately once onboarding has started.

prompt: Can I carry over unused vacation days into next year?

reply.message: Here is what company policy says. Paid time off (POL-PTO-01): Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid time off per year (1.67 days per month). Up to 5 unused days carry over into the next year; the rest expire on December 31. Interns accrue 1 day per month. Contractors do not accrue PTO. Book PTO in the HR portal; absences of 3 or more consecutive working days need 2 weeks' notice.

prompt: Can I work from home a few days a week?

reply.message: Here is what company policy says. Remote and hybrid work (POL-REM-01): Office-based employees may work remotely up to 2 days a week, agreed with their manager. Fully remote arrangements need VP approval. Working from another country is allowed for up to 20 working days per calendar year and needs HR approval at least 2 weeks in advance.

prompt: Is there a home office stipend?

reply.message: Here is what company policy says. Laptops and equipment (POL-EQP-01): Every employee gets a company laptop, replaced every 3 years. A lost or stolen laptop or phone must be reported to IT within 24 hours so it can be locked and wiped; the helpdesk escalates these to IT. Full-time employees can claim a one-time home-office stipend of up to $300 through expenses. Personal devices may access email and team chat only, through the company app.

prompt: How long do I have to submit an expense report?

reply.message: Here is what company policy says. Expenses (POL-EXP-01): Submit expenses in the HR portal within 30 days, with a receipt for anything over $25. Meals while travelling are covered up to $75 per day. Your manager approves expenses; a single expense over $1,000 also needs your department head. Alcohol is not reimbursed unless it is part of an approved client event.

prompt: Can I fly premium economy to the Frankfurt conference? It's an 8-hour flight.

reply.message: Here is what company policy says. Business travel (POL-TRV-01): Book flights and hotels through the travel desk at least 14 days ahead where possible. Economy class for flights under 6 hours; premium economy is allowed for longer flights. Travel needs your manager's approval before booking.

prompt: How do I reset my password?

reply.message: You can reset your password or MFA yourself at reset.fernhollow.test using your registered phone; the helpdesk can't reset it over chat. Passwords and multi-factor authentication (POL-PWD-01): The helpdesk never resets passwords or MFA over chat, for anyone. Employees reset their own password and MFA at the self-service portal, reset.fernhollow.test, using their registered phone. An employee who cannot use self-service (lost phone, locked out of the portal) is escalated to IT, who verify identity on a video call before resetting anything. Nobody may ask the helpdesk to reset another person's password.
